candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately after loop completes (original returns true).
Replace the final return with returning the success value of the last internal call instead of a constant true.
Return the negation of the original true (i.e., return '!true' -> false) by replacing the return statement with 'return !true;'.
Change the low-level call to use call{value: v} so ETH value is forwarded to the callee, altering side effects and observable behavior.
Change the called selector to call a different function signature transferFrom(address,address,uint256,bytes) which will likely result in different behavior or revert.
Invert the require on the loop to require that each low-level call fails, changing observable outcomes.
Stop requiring _tos non-empty, allowing empty arrays and changing observable behavior when called with empty array.
Change loop to iterate from 1 to _tos.length (skipping first recipient), altering which calls occur and observable transfers.
